title: Walking Into Their World
narrativeText: You've seen extreme matches on tape. Nothing prepares you for the real thing. The crowd barely acknowledges you as you enter — you're not one of them. Not yet.

choices.label: Step Into the Ring
choices.text: The only way to earn respect here is to bleed for it.

title: Respect or Fear
narrativeText: {{RIVAL}} hasn't forgotten last time. They find you in the back and make it clear: this ends between you two, extreme rules, no excuses.

choices.label: Face Your Extreme Rival
choices.text: Running isn't an option. This is the world you chose.

title: Learning Their Language
narrativeText: Steel chairs. Tables. Barbwire. In a normal match, these are disqualifications. Here, they're vocabulary. Tonight you learn to speak extreme fluently.

choices.label: Fight Their Way
choices.text: When in the extreme underground, do as the extreme fighters do.

title: One of Them Steps Up
narrativeText: One of the four — the most skeptical — approaches you backstage. No ambush. A match. Clean... well, as clean as extreme gets. They want to know if you truly belong.

choices.label: Accept the Challenge
choices.text: If this is the test, you'll pass it.

title: The Extreme Gauntlet
narrativeText: All four of them are watching from ringside. Only one will fight, but all four are judging. Win this and you have earned the right to chase the Extreme Championship.

choices.label: Run the Gauntlet
choices.text: One extreme legend at a time. You can do this.
